author: PostOakLabs
description: Vendor-neutral break-even and TCO comparison across tokenization vault, network token, hosted fields, and proxy passthrough card-data architectures. The user supplies every number: card-processing volume, distinct cards, per-call vendor fee and one-time integration cost per architecture, annual assessment cost per declared SAQ level, and the horizon in years. Outputs horizon TCO per architecture, pairwise break-even volumes with quotients and remainders, SAQ-level cost deltas, and a per-card volume statistic, all in fixed-point BigInt minor units with no floating point in any calculation. SAQ level meanings are not cited; each declared level is treated as a user label. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.
